summary: inclusionai/ming-image-0.1-design-layer is a free image-to-image model on OpenRouter (served by NovitaAI): decomposes a flattened design image into separate RGBA layers. $0 input/output image-token pricing, PNG/WebP output. Requires exactly one reference image and a prompt describing the layer plan; output dimensions follow the input image, so explicit sizes and aspect ratios are rejected.
claim_steps: Create or sign in to an OpenRouter account and create an API key at https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys.

Call POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/images with model inclusionai/ming-image-0.1-design-layer, exactly one input_references image, and a prompt describing the layer plan. Do not set explicit output sizes or aspect ratios.
